column1: # Lucene 10.5.0 lucene-spatial3d: every top-level class of the jar, and what became of it.
# Checked by scripts/check-port-inventory.py --module spatial3d (see its docstring for the statuses).

column3: crates/lucene-index/src/document/geo3d.rs::Geo3DPoint -- its query factories are lucene-search document/geo/geo3d.rs::geo3d_point
crates/lucene-search/src/document/geo/sort.rs::Geo3DDistance -- each document's own values are read (Lucene's re-reads a multi-valued document's values in copy(); see docs/parity.md)

crates/lucene-search/src/document/geo/geo3d.rs::from_polygon -- with from_large_polygon, from_path, from_distance, from_box, decode_value_floor/ceil; fromDegrees is lucene-index document/geo3d.rs::from_degrees
crates/lucene-util/src/spatial3d/distance_style.rs::DistanceStyle -- the five Java distance classes are one enum; this is DistanceStyle::Arc
crates/lucene-util/src/spatial3d/shape.rs::PlanetObject -- the abstract base is the trait
crates/lucene-util/src/spatial3d/xyz_solid.rs::XYZSolid -- the shared solid code is free functions beside the trait
crates/lucene-util/src/spatial3d/shape.rs::base_get_relationship -- the abstract base as a free function
crates/lucene-util/src/spatial3d/shape.rs::base_get_bounds -- the abstract base as a free function
crates/lucene-util/src/spatial3d/geo_composite.rs::composite_area_shape -- the generic bases are one macro per member interface
crates/lucene-util/src/spatial3d/geo_composite.rs::composite_shape -- the generic bases are one macro per member interface
crates/lucene-util/src/spatial3d/geo_composite.rs::composite_shape -- the generic bases are one macro per member interface

crates/lucene-util/src/spatial3d/shape.rs::base_get_bounds -- the abstract base as a free function
crates/lucene-util/src/spatial3d/shape.rs::SerializableObject -- the stream helpers are serializable.rs and standard_objects.rs
